notes: MACULA distributes the gloss of שִׁבְתָּם across its segments in reverse (rule 39); the surface and morphology give s001 the infinitive 'sitting' and s002 the suffix.
The suffix on the infinitive construct is its subject under rule 18, but the ASV writes it as the possessive 'their', which is the word aligned.
The paragogic he on הַבִּיטָה is its own unrepresented unit under rule 32.
